run.label: frames, and talk that has nothing to do with fire

turns.text: The kids are at school, so it is quiet today.
We painted the shed last spring.

findings.instruction: Move the wood pile more than 30 feet from the house, or cover it completely with fire resistant material.
findings.reason: Frames show an uncovered stack of logs sitting against the wall.

findings.instruction: Replace the wooden fence near the house with fire resistant material.
findings.reason: Frames show a wooden fence attached near the house wall.

findings.instruction: Remove dry brush within 30 feet of the house.
findings.reason: Frames show dead branches lying on the ground near the wall.
